discovery.title: Resolving the gravitational redshift across a millimetre-scale atomic sample
discovery.purpose: Define the measured frequency-gradient observable, reported uncertainty and corrections. Use primary publication and its own supplementary information as one dependence group, not independent replications.
discovery.prior_exposure: The title, abstract, broad experimental conclusion and abstract-level frequency-precision figure were inspected during goal selection. This is not blind data.

validation.title: Optical Clocks and Relativity
validation.purpose: An independently performed elevation/clock-frequency comparison; confirm primary metadata before extracting numerical observations. No parameter, observable, scorer or uncertainty rule may be changed after validation disclosure.
validation.prior_exposure: The paper and its broad conclusion are established background knowledge. No blinding, prospective experiment, new TECT prediction or statistical independence beyond the actual disclosed lineage is claimed.

data_roles.prospective_holdout: EMPTY: these published experiments cannot count as a prospective TECT prediction.
data_roles.raw_data_rule: If only published aggregates are available, label AGGREGATE_ONLY. Do not reconstruct unpublished samples, assume an unavailable covariance is zero, fit a covariance, or treat digitized points as raw observations.
data_roles.source_capture: Hash exact primary PDF bytes and retain retrieval URL/date and page/figure locators. Keep full third-party documents in ignored local evidence cache unless redistribution rights are verified; public manifest and reproducible retrieval references retain provenance.

observable_contract.definition: Clock transition frequency for species/mechanism i and comparison condition a, transported to one declared readout convention with stated kinematic, field, instrumental and gravitational-model corrections. This is not a Markov spectral decay rate.
observable_contract.analytic_target: Characterize, for a finite complete positive frequency table, when omega[i,a]=k[i]*N[a] for positive factors. Separate arbitrary factor normalization, incomplete observation graphs, covariance propagation and finite uncertainty from exact algebraic identities.
observable_contract.falsifier: A demonstrably non-unit double ratio under the declared common comparison and uncertainty convention rejects exact common factorization for that table. It does not by itself identify a gravity theory or reject all microscopic models.
observable_contract.non_identifiability_test: Determine whether common factorization, even if supported, distinguishes a metric lapse from an otherwise unspecified universal environmental multiplier. Do not choose one equivalent explanation by naming it gravity.
observable_contract.data_applicability: Single-species frequency gradients do not supply a complete multi-species table. Independent experiments at different potentials or readout conditions cannot be silently combined into one exact double ratio.

candidate_contract.functional_and_time: Exactly the existing A2 scalar real-field L2 gradient flow: partial_t phi=-K(-i nabla)phi-lambda phi^3-gamma phi^5, K(q)=mu^2+Y(q^2-q0^2)^2. No new noise, inertia, transfer, counterterm, quantization or time conversion.
candidate_contract.scope: Fixed periodic T^3, Y>0, mu^2>0, gamma>0, 3/2<s<=2, inherited source assumptions. No continuum, thermodynamic or condensate limit is attempted.
candidate_contract.observable_map_test: Check only declared source fields for a map from the existing response to a measured clock transition and common readout time. An absent map is NOT_ADMITTED, not a numerical failure or all-Brazovskii no-go.
candidate_contract.legacy_boundary: Other Brazovskii/Langevin/Model A-star names remain reference-only proposals; no new completion is adopted. The earlier dynamical-underdetermination result is background, not a new proof to repeat.
candidate_contract.pah_boundary: Keep PAH-v1, PAH-v2, original external Markov time and R-574 comparison unchanged. No PAH recalculation or weakened successor.

one_attempt.budget: One source/observable freeze and one exact algebraic plus candidate-applicability audit; one integrated primary/independent/hostile verification package and partial Lean if feasible. No parameter search or finite carrier sweep.
one_attempt.completion: Versioned evidence/validation manifest with exact hashes and located inputs; observation/candidate crosswalk; precise conditional algebra and non-identifiability boundary; reproducible checks; one bounded terminal assessment; exploration and appropriate existing authorities; one checkpoint synthesis only if warranted.
one_attempt.separate_fields: Record the algebraic result, empirical identifiability and candidate-map admission independently. A candidate-map absence does not erase valid diagnostic algebra, and diagnostic algebra does not promote the candidate.
one_attempt.stop_rule: If the physical map is missing, name the single missing packet and exact reentry condition. Do not repeatedly search unchanged owners, fill it by analogy, or start an automatic successor.

verification_plan: Primary: exact ratio/factorization identities and transparent source-value/units checks.
Independent: non-importing cross-product or logarithmic-rank derivation; independent extraction of primary page values.

Hostile: sign, units, uncertainty-versus-redshift precision, covariance, dependence-group leakage, incomplete-table, rate/frequency substitution, common-factor non-identifiability and candidate-scope mutations.
Lean: only parameterized finite algebra if feasible; never empirical truth, data provenance, GR, candidate identity or a new physical time.
non_claims: No mainline gate closure follows from preregistration or diagnostic algebra.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, horizon, causal cone, continuum, Yang-Mills, mass gap or TOE conclusion.
Rindler/Unruh is theoretical context, not direct experimental data in this packet.
No single clock establishes universality and no retrospective agreement is a new prediction.
No claim that static functional or dissipative time uniquely determines microscopic physical dynamics.
